assessment_area: Sub-Antarctic biological stock (HAK 1 south of Otago Peninsula; includes Puysegur Bank)
selection_basis: The latest detailed 2024 run provides numeric survey biomass and biological tables, sex-specific age compositions, and tabulated posterior biomass outputs. A supporting catch-at-age report provides 2023-24 fishery and survey age numbers. The numerical historical composition series will be audited before completeness is assigned.

assessment_area: West Coast South Island biological stock (HAK 7)
selection_basis: The latest detailed 2024 run provides a numeric Tangaroa biomass series and biological tables, age-composition likelihood descriptions, and tabulated posterior biomass outputs. Supporting age estimates for 2023-24 are available but must remain separate from the fitted observations ending in 2022 for fishery age and 2021 for survey age.
